arguments.query: SELECT s.*, o.order_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) LIMIT 5

SELECT count(*), sum(delivered_ts IS NULL), sum(delivered_ts=''), count(distinct order_id), min(length(shipped_ts)), max(length(shipped_ts)), min(length(delivered_ts)), max(length(delivered_ts)) FROM shipments

SELECT count(*) n, sum((julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts))<=3.0) ontime, round(100.0*sum((julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts))<=3.0)/count(*),4) pct, sum((julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts))<0) neg FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2026-01-01'

SELECT count(*) n, sum(strftime('%s',s.delivered_ts)-strftime('%s',s.shipped_ts)<=259200) ontime, round(100.0*sum(strftime('%s',s.delivered_ts)-strftime('%s',s.shipped_ts)<=259200)/count(*),4) pct FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2026-01-01'
